{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Homer City Generating Station Gas Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://files.dep.state.pa.us/RegionalResources/NWRO/NWROPortalFiles/Homer-City/Waterways%20Engineering%20and%20Wetlands/PAD320011/Review/HCPP%20Public%20Hearing%20Factsheet.pdf|title=files.dep.state.pa.us|website=files.dep.state.pa.us|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.monvalleyindependent.com/2026/05/14/natural-gas-pipeline-hearing-draws-fierce-pushback-over-homer-city-data-center-project/|title=monvalleyindependent.com|website=monvalleyindependent.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Metering and interconnect facility, Burrell Township, Pennsylvania to Homer City Generating Station, Center Township, Pennsylvania.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://files.dep.state.pa.us/RegionalResources/NWRO/NWROPortalFiles/Homer-City/Waterways%20Engineering%20and%20Wetlands/PAD320011/Review/HCPP%20Public%20Hearing%20Factsheet.pdf|title=files.dep.state.pa.us|website=files.dep.state.pa.us|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
